name: CanonicalWireframe NodeTypes
purpose: Define CanonicalWireframe NodeTypes, Entity-local Property expectations, mandatory canonical Link attachments, generic abstraction boundary NodeTypes, and abstraction-local Binding semantics using Canonical Contract Format 2.0.

model.ccf: Defines canonical Entity and Property structure.
model.nodetypes: Define what Property types an Entity owns or is expected to own and which canonical Link attachments are mandatory for readiness.
model.rulesets: Interpret canonical Property values, Link semantics, endpoint roles, causality, flow, Link ownership/placement and unresolved impact direction.
model.projection: Consumes resolved semantic/readiness state but never becomes canonical authority.

rules: Entity.entity_type_ref resolves a NodeType by id inside the active NodeTypes registry.
NodeTypes describe Entity-local Property expectations and Required Link declarations.
NodeTypes do not define Property value semantics.
NodeTypes do not define Link direction, Link Property placement, flow semantics, causality, rendering, animation, geometry or layout.
Additional Properties may exist when their Rulesets resolve them.
Required Links declare canonical Link attachments that must exist for readiness.
Every effective Required Link entry is mandatory; Required Links are evaluated as AND, never OR.
Multiple Required Link entries may use the same link_type_ref and MUST NOT be deduplicated by Link type.
A concrete Required Link requirement is identified by requiring Entity id plus Required Link id.
Only canonical Link Properties explicitly bound to that concrete requirement through value.required_link_ref satisfy it.
A canonical Link may satisfy at most one concrete Required Link requirement.
Derived/projected Links and unbound ordinary Links do not satisfy Required Links.
Missing required Properties or Required Links make the Entity UNRESOLVED/unready; they do not make otherwise well-formed canonical data INVALID.

semantics.required_property_types: Minimum local Property types expected for readiness.
semantics.owned_property_types: Property types structurally associated with this NodeType. This is not a closed allow-list.
semantics.extends: Optional inheritance from other NodeTypes. Effective Required Links retain stable requirement ids through inheritance.
semantics.property_cardinality: Optional readiness constraints for local Property counts.
semantics.required_links: Independent mandatory canonical Link attachment requirements. Entries are conjunctive and retain stable ids.

semantics.id: Stable requirement declaration id within the effective NodeType inheritance closure.
semantics.self_role: Semantic role the requiring Entity must occupy under the governing Link Ruleset.
semantics.min: Minimum number of distinct canonical Link Properties explicitly bound to this requirement instance.
semantics.max: Optional maximum number of canonical Link Properties explicitly bound to this requirement instance.
semantics.other_endpoint: Optional constraints on the opposite canonical endpoint.

required_link_schema.conjunction: Every effective Required Link entry is mandatory.
required_link_schema.duplicate_types: Two entries with the same link_type_ref remain separate requirements.

nodetypes.name: Input
nodetypes.description: The one generic canonical inbound Abstraction boundary NodeType.
constraints: Input is a real canonical Entity inside an Abstraction.
Input does not encode or copy transported semantic type/signature.
Transported semantics are derived from the explicit canonical internal attachment/binding or exposed Required Link.
An Input exposing an unsatisfied Required Link does not itself satisfy that Required Link.
Event boundaries use this same generic Input NodeType; no Event-specific Input NodeType exists.

nodetypes.name: Output
nodetypes.description: The one generic canonical outbound Abstraction boundary NodeType.
constraints: Output is a real canonical Entity inside an Abstraction.
Output does not encode or copy transported semantic type/signature.
Transported semantics are derived from the explicit canonical internal attachment/binding or selected abstraction-local Binding identity.
Output creates no analogous inbound requirement.
Event boundaries use this same generic Output NodeType; no Event-specific Output NodeType exists.

nodetypes.name: Binding
constraints: Binding is valid only inside exactly one Abstraction semantic source.
Top-level Workspace Binding use is forbidden.
Cross-Abstraction Binding lookup is forbidden.
Binding Entity.name is the machine-significant Binding symbol and must be unique among Binding Entities in the same Abstraction.
A resolved Binding has exactly one incoming canonical semantic source at a time; absence while authoring is UNRESOLVED.
Binding accepts only canonical Link types whose governing Ruleset permits the Binding Entity in the relevant endpoint role.
Binding defines no universal special Link type and bypasses no Ruleset.
Binding semantic type/signature is derived from its connected canonical source endpoint and governing Ruleset and is never independently copied.
Output consumers select a Binding by canonical Binding Entity identity, not by free-text name.
Any number of Output nodes inside the same Abstraction may select the same Binding.
Binding lookup is non-spatial within its containing Abstraction.
Binding identity does not become part of the parent-level Abstraction interface.
Binding trace visualization is transient projection only and creates no canonical Link.

required_link_readiness.ready: Every effective Required Link requirement instance satisfies its own minimum through distinct canonical Link Properties explicitly bound using value.required_link_ref.
required_link_readiness.unready: At least one concrete Required Link requirement instance is below its minimum.
required_link_readiness.requirement_identity: requiring Entity id + Required Link id
required_link_readiness.same_link_type: Multiple requirements of the same Link type remain independent.

readiness.ready: The Entity satisfies required Properties, Property cardinalities and every concrete Required Link requirement used by active evaluation.
readiness.unready: One or more expected NodeType Properties, Property cardinalities or Required Link attachments are unresolved or missing.

resolution.rule: Entity.entity_type_ref resolves a local NodeType id inside the explicitly active CW_NODETYPES registry. Local ids do not become globally unique merely by spelling.
